Right after, a guard raises an error if fixed.pi_T != source_prior.

checks.claim: §0.1: the only difference is the switch at _variant_core L406 (fixed_prior = pi_S_t if spec.update=="prior_fixed"), which skips the prior M-step at L243-245
checks.evidence: L406 is exactly `fixed_prior = pi_S_t if spec.update == "prior_fixed" else None`. L243 `if fixed_prior is None:`, L244 counts=r.sum(0), L245 pi_T=(counts+anchor)/(...) is the prior M-step. The two specs share responsibility=gen_iterative, kind=diag_affine and restarts=1. fit_variant seeds the fit from tta_seed plus the restart index, not the variant name. The runner passes both variants the same tta_seed. No other code path branches on update between prior_fixed and joint.

checks.claim: §2.3(a) P13 geometry displacement: FP ≈1.4 like Joint — q=0.1 FP 1.414 vs Joint 1.436; q=0.9 FP 1.404 vs Joint 1.424 (fp_gem_prevalence_geometry_diagnostic.csv @b5fb5158)
checks.evidence: origin/exp/h2cmi-wave0-mechanism (df47753e) and b5fb5158 hold the same file (md5 0dbfda62…). It has 972 rows, Lee2019_MI only, 162 units per q×method cell. Mean geometry_displacement_from_q05 is FP 1.414391 and Joint 1.435709 at q=0.1, and FP 1.404000 and Joint 1.424357 at q=0.9 (medians 1.405/1.423 and 1.405/1.420). The FP fitted prior is 0.5 in every row, so FP's ~1.4 shift happens with no prior update. Joint's mean fitted class-0 prior is 0.4636 / 0.4850 / 0.5007 at q=0.1/0.5/0.9.
checks.correction: None for the numbers; they are cell means. Two caveats. First, the file cannot tell whether the ~1.4 comes from the change in class composition or from drawing a different subsample, because there is no same-q resampling control, so 'geometry absorbs prevalence' is not shown either. Second, T9 in EXECUTION_KICKOFF_sprint0.md L96 compares against the P13 prior movement (Joint 0.46→0.50), not the geometry displacement. That comparison is still valid, so saying T9 must be redefined is stronger than the evidence supports.

checks.claim: v1 §2.2(b) and v4 P7 cite 'geometry displacement ~1.4' from P13 as evidence about Joint's prior/geometry coupling
checks.evidence: v1 REVISION_PLAN_TSP_TPAMI.md L83 table: 'Geometry displacement @ q=0.1 / 0.9 | 1.436 / 1.424 | 1.414 / 1.404' (Joint | FP), so v1 does print the FP values. L86-87: 'Joint's prior barely moves (0.46→0.50), yet the geometry shifts by 1.4 … the likelihood along the prior direction is flat, and the offset is absorbed by the geometry'. v4 REVISION_PLAN_v4_positive_claims.md L78, under P7: 'the jointly estimated prior only moves from 0.46 to 0.50; geometry displacement 1.4 (P13, already available)'.
checks.correction: Both documents do cite the ~1.4 as Joint-mechanism evidence. But they frame it as weak prior identifiability, where the Joint prior stays flat and the geometry absorbs the shift, not as the prior pushing the geometry. v1 §2.3 item 2 even says FP≈Joint on MI, and v1 already prints the FP values next to Joint's. The report's core point stands: FP shows the same ~1.4 with its prior fixed, so the number cannot support a Joint-specific mechanism.

checks.claim: §3 MI readout: frozen TSMNet linear classifier used for predictions (not density argmax + uniform π_dec per Eq 12)
